report.comparison_policy: Exact raw binary32 including NaN payload/sign/quiet bits. No normalization or numerical tolerance.
report.scalar_admission_policy: Observe requested f32 word, Python f64 Scalar word and admitted f32 word. Native comparison must use admitted f32 bits for the Python Scalar contract.

report.scope: Six finite shared-owner contracts; no repeated profile executions counted as API coverage.
report.test_numerics: Exact dyadic Fractions and raw binary32 bits; no floating tolerance.

report.comparison_policy: Exact admission, shape, all element strides, offsets, storage bytes, Version, requires_grad, every raw binary32 word, and identity relations. No tolerance and no expected failure count.
report.identity_comparison: Opaque identity values are compared only through exact observed relations, not process-specific numeric IDs.
